baseline_reuse_evidence: All79 baseline trajectories are actual executions of selected0.56.0 listed in default_records. This study uses their actual observations, decisions and costs; no behavior-equivalence substitution or new baseline optimizer execution is claimed.
method: Start from selected0.56.0 with its objective research unchanged. Decompose an accepted constraint program into additive terms while preserving nonlinear mechanisms. Fit an independent coefficient-GP readout to all paid current-scope data using GLS parameter plus point-deviation covariance and correctly shared replicates. Moment-match three alternatives into the native GP: old affine readout, frozen program and new term readout. Algebraically remap the first two to the term basis preserving their means and covariances. Start the new component at uniform prior weight, then update using future likelihood only. Record model fitting work and fitted rows in native diagnostics. Development initialization and evaluation are reused unchanged; any fresh initialization uses frozen0.56.0. Keep32 initialization plus32 online calls and all existing objective/constraint research limits.
selection: The70 preceding development cases and9 completed dual-value confirmation cases form79 development and retention cases. The five named smoke cases cover the largest constraint-prediction regression, another constraint-prediction regression, delayed objective adoption and two actual goal improvements. All66 unknown-goal cases retain native controls. All79 baseline records are actual selected0.56.0 trajectories. Count the five smoke cases once when extending to full79. The preceding107 optimizations and 4768 physical calls are historical and excluded from this study's new-call ledger.
accounting: Development purchases79 times32 online vectors:2528. Independent9-case confirmation uses six shared32-vector initializations,27 optimizers times32 online calls, and nine128-vector final evaluations:2208. Initialization research uses frozen default0.56.0. Total if both phases complete:106 optimizer runs and4736 physical calls. Report controller operations, native KG and optimizer time separately; each paid vector produces both outputs.
limitations: The79 existing cases are development evidence. New9 cases remain unrun unless development supports continuing, and use the unchanged frozen method and seeds. Native SC-KG comparisons condition on shared paid initialization. Both-infeasible results are separate from improvements. Historical walltime is not a simultaneous throughput test; previous backend clock anomalies preclude inferring speed from those timings.
